accountDeletion.pageDescription: This page explains how to request deletion of your account and the data associated with it.
accountDeletion.pageDescriptionWithApp: This page explains how to request deletion of your {{appName}} account and the data associated with it.

fromApp.subtitle: From inside the app
fromApp.text: Sign in, open the profile menu in the top navigation bar, and choose Delete Account. Confirm when prompted. Your account is closed immediately and you are signed out on every device.

byEmail.subtitle: By email, if you cannot sign in
byEmail.text: Email {{email}} from the email address registered on your account, with the subject "Account deletion request". Tell us the name of your institute so we can locate your record. We acknowledge every request within 7 days.

within30Days.subtitle: Deleted within 30 days of your request
within30Days.text: Your profile information (name, email address, phone number and profile photo), the doubts and messages you posted, your enrolment records, your learning progress, and your assessment attempts and scores.

dataKept.title: Data that is kept, and for how long

paymentRecords.subtitle: Payment and invoice records
paymentRecords.text: Where you have made a payment, we are required to retain the invoice and transaction record under Indian tax and accounting law. These are kept for 8 years from the end of the relevant financial year and are not deleted on request.

anonymisedStats.subtitle: Anonymised usage statistics
anonymisedStats.text: Aggregate statistics that can no longer be linked back to you (for example, how many learners completed a course) are retained. These contain no personal information.

whatHappens.subtitle: What happens when
whatHappens.text: Access ends immediately once the request is made. Personal data is erased within 30 days. Records we are legally required to keep are retained for the periods described above and for no longer than necessary.

header.title: Privacy Policy
header.description: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how {{appName}} collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

identity.title: Who this policy covers
identity.intro: This Privacy Policy applies to the {{appName}} mobile applications for Android and iOS and to the {{appName}} web portal (together, the "Service"). It is the privacy policy linked from the {{appName}} listings on Google Play and the Apple App Store and from inside the app.
identity.introWeb: This Privacy Policy applies to the {{appName}} web portal (the "Service") and to any {{appName}} mobile application published by {{publisher}}.
identity.controller: {{appName}} is developed and published by {{publisher}}, which is responsible for the personal information collected through the Service. Where the Service is provided on behalf of an educational institution or organisation, that institution decides which learners are enrolled and what content they receive, and can see learner progress within the Service.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text: Welcome to {{appName}}. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our educational platform and services. Please read this policy carefully to understand our practices regarding your personal data.

personalInformation.subtitle: Personal Information
personalInformation.text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, enroll in courses, or contact us. This may include your name, email address, phone number, educational background, and payment information.

learningData.subtitle: Learning Data
learningData.text: We collect information about your learning activities, including course progress, assessment scores, time spent on materials, and interaction patterns to personalize your learning experience.

technicalInformation.subtitle: Technical Information
technicalInformation.text: We automatically collect certain technical information about your device and how you interact with our platform, including IP address, browser type, operating system, and usage analytics.

devicePermissions.subtitle: Device permissions
devicePermissions.text: The {{appName}} app asks for your permission before using your camera or microphone, and only does so for live classes and video features you choose to join. It may ask to access your photo library so you can upload assignments or a profile picture, and to send you notifications about your courses. Notifications are delivered through Firebase Cloud Messaging, which involves a device token being stored with your account. The app does not access your contacts or your precise location.

educationalServices.subtitle: Educational Services
educationalServices.text: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our educational services, including delivering course content, tracking progress, and providing certifications.

personalization.subtitle: Personalization
personalization.text: We analyze your learning patterns to recommend relevant courses, customize content delivery, and optimize your learning experience.

communication.subtitle: Communication
communication.text: We may use your contact information to send you important updates about your courses, platform changes, and educational opportunities that may interest you.

educationalPartners.subtitle: Educational Partners
educationalPartners.text: If you use {{appName}} through a school, coaching institute, employer or other organisation, we share your enrolment details, learning progress and assessment results with that organisation so it can deliver and evaluate your learning. We may also share achievements with institutions or employers as authorised by you or as required for certification purposes.

serviceProviders.subtitle: Service Providers
serviceProviders.text: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform, conducting business, or serving our users.

legalRequirements.subtitle: Legal Requirements
legalRequirements.text: We may disclose your information when required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of {{publisher}}, {{appName}}, our users, or others.

thirdPartyServices.subtitle: Third-party services
thirdPartyServices.text: {{appName}} relies on a small number of third-party providers that process data on our behalf: Firebase (Google) for push notifications; Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple when you choose to log in with those accounts; payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, Cashfree, PhonePe or PayPal when you purchase a course (your card or bank details are entered directly with the gateway and are never stored by us); and video hosting and live-class providers such as YouTube, Vimeo, Zoom or BigBlueButton when you watch or attend a class. Each provider handles your data under its own privacy policy.

securityMeasures.subtitle: Security Measures
securityMeasures.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

encryption.subtitle: Encryption
encryption.text: We use industry-standard encryption protocols to protect sensitive data during transmission and storage, including SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers.

accessControls.subtitle: Access Controls
accessControls.text: We maintain strict access controls and regularly audit our systems to ensure that only authorized personnel can access your personal information.

accessAndCorrection.subtitle: Access and Correction
accessAndCorrection.text: You have the right to access, update, or correct your personal information at any time through your account settings or by contacting us directly.

dataPortability.subtitle: Data Portability
dataPortability.text: You may request a copy of your personal information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format for transfer to another service.

deletion.subtitle: Deletion
deletion.text: You may request deletion of your personal information at any time, subject to certain exceptions where we may need to retain information for legal or legitimate business purposes. See "Data retention and deletion" below for how to delete your account.

retentionPeriod.subtitle: How long we keep your data
retentionPeriod.text: We keep your account information and learning records for as long as your {{appName}} account is active, so that your progress, certificates and purchases remain available to you. Payment records are kept for as long as tax and accounting laws require.

accountDeletion.subtitle: Deleting your account
accountDeletion.text: You can delete your {{appName}} account and the personal data associated with it from within the app (Profile → Delete account) or by emailing {{email}} from the address registered to your account. Once a deletion request is verified, your personal data is deleted or anonymised within 30 days, except for records we are legally required to retain.

learnersUnder18.subtitle: Learners under 18
learnersUnder18.text: {{appName}} is an educational service and may be used by learners under 18. Accounts for such learners are created by, or with the consent of, a parent, guardian or the educational institution that enrols them. We collect only the information needed to deliver the learning service and do not knowingly use children's data for advertising. A parent or guardian can review or delete a child's information by contacting us.

globalOperations.subtitle: Global Operations
globalOperations.text: {{publisher}} is based in India and hosts the Service on servers that may be located outside your country of residence, including countries that may have different data protection laws.

safeguards.subtitle: Safeguards
safeguards.text: When we transfer your information internationally, we implement appropriate safeguards to ensure your information receives adequate protection, including standard contractual clauses and adequacy decisions.

notification.subtitle: How we notify you
notification.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised, and the current version is always available from the {{appName}} app and its store listings. Where a change materially affects how we use your personal information, we will notify you in the app or by email before it takes effect.

contact.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

privacyPolicy.footer: This privacy policy is effective as of {{date}} and will remain in effect except with respect to any changes in its provisions in the future.

welcome.intro2: Your access to and use of the service is conditioned on your acceptance of and compliance with these Terms. These Terms apply to all visitors, users, and others who access or use the service.

agreement.text: By accessing and using Vacademy's educational platform, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

creation.text: To access certain features of our platform, you must register for an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process and to update such information to keep it accurate, current, and complete.

security.subtitle: Account Security
security.text: You are responsible for safeguarding the password and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to immediately notify Vacademy of any unauthorized use of your account or any other breach of security.

courseAccess.subtitle: Course Access
courseAccess.text: Upon enrollment and payment, you will receive access to course materials for the duration specified in your enrollment agreement. Access may be limited by time, device, or other restrictions as specified in the course description.

learningMaterials.subtitle: Learning Materials
learningMaterials.text: All course materials, including videos, documents, assessments, and other content, are provided for educational purposes only. You may not redistribute, reproduce, or share these materials without explicit permission.

processing.subtitle: Payment Processing
processing.text: All payments are processed securely through our approved payment processors. You agree to provide accurate payment information and authorize us to charge the specified amounts for your selected courses or services.

refunds.subtitle: Refund Policy
refunds.text: Refunds are available within 30 days of course enrollment, provided that less than 25% of the course content has been accessed. Refund requests must be submitted through our official channels and may take 5-10 business days to process.

acceptableUse.subtitle: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.text: You agree to use the platform only for lawful educational purposes and in a manner that does not infringe upon the rights of others or restrict or inhibit their use and enjoyment of the platform.

prohibited.subtitle: Prohibited Activities
prohibited.text: You may not: share account credentials, attempt to gain unauthorized access to the platform, upload malicious software, engage in academic dishonesty, harass other users, or use the platform for any commercial purpose without authorization.
